# FUSIONest Pro

> Workforce, attendance and project management platform for construction teams.

FUSIONest Pro is an offline-ready web app used by construction supervisors and management to manage workers, track real-time biometric attendance, run projects, fill checklists, and generate reports.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Sign in to the FUSIONest Pro workforce and project management platform.
- [Face Attendance](/attendance-scan): Public biometric face-attendance kiosk for workers to check in and out on-site.
